rules.source_supported_criterion: Epidural steroid injections (ESI) are indicated for radicular pain corresponding to nerve root distribution with functional impairment (pain >= 6/10) after failure of >= 6 weeks conservative therapy within prior 6 months. Fluoroscopic or CT guidance required.
rules.evidence: Citation mismatch and uncompiled stub. Rule cites physical page 4 (Page 1 of 13), which is the Table of Contents / Guideline Header. Actual clinical criteria are on physical pages 6–8 (Pages 3–5 of 13). Condition is a single stub "cgepiduralinjections_indication IS_PRESENT".
rules.recommended_correction: Update citation to physical pages 6–8 and compile multi-factorial criteria: radiculopathy, pain >= 6/10, conservative care >= 6 weeks, fluoroscopic guidance.

rules.source_section: Epidural Spine Injections 2026 / Conservative Treatment Prerequisites
rules.source_supported_criterion: Epidural steroid injection conservative therapy failure requirement: lack of meaningful improvement after >= 6 weeks active conservative care within prior 6 months.
rules.evidence: Citation mismatch. Rule cites physical page 11 (Page 8 of 13), which is the "Conditions which may be contraindications to epidural injections" section, rather than the primary clinical necessity criteria section on pages 6–8.
rules.recommended_correction: Update citation to physical pages 6–8 and align condition parameters with comprehensive ESI clinical criteria.

rules.source_section: Paravertebral Facet Joint Injection or Blocks 2026 (July)
rules.source_supported_criterion: Paravertebral facet joint injections/blocks are indicated for axial spine pain >= 3 months causing functional disability (pain >= 6/10), after failure of >= 6 weeks conservative therapy within last 6 months. Must be performed under fluoroscopy or CT guidance. Initial diagnostic relief >= 80%.
rules.evidence: Citation mismatch and uncompiled stub. Rule cites physical page 31 (Page 1 of 14), which is the Table of Contents / Header. Clinical criteria are on physical pages 33–35. Condition is a single stub "cgfacetblocks_indication IS_PRESENT".
rules.recommended_correction: Update citation to physical pages 33–35 and compile explicit clinical criteria: axial pain >= 3 months, pain >= 6, conservative care >= 6 weeks, image guidance.

rules.source_section: Paravertebral Facet Joint Denervation 2026 (July)
rules.source_supported_criterion: Facet joint radiofrequency neurotomy/denervation is indicated after failure of conservative care for >= 6 weeks in the last 6 months, and documented positive response to prior diagnostic facet blocks.

rules.source_section: Paravertebral Facet Joint Denervation 2026 / Diagnostic Block Prerequisites
rules.source_supported_criterion: Facet joint radiofrequency neurotomy requires positive response to diagnostic facet joint injections with at least 50% (or 80% per diagnostic phase) pain relief and functional improvement.
rules.evidence: Citation mismatch. Rule cites physical page 46 (Statement / General Information) instead of physical page 47 where the diagnostic block response criteria and percentage thresholds are detailed.
rules.recommended_correction: Update citation to physical page 47 and confirm whether diagnostic threshold is 80% (initial dual blocks) or 50% (subsequent/repeat).

rules.source_section: Implantable Infusion Pump Insert 2026 (July)
rules.source_supported_criterion: Intrathecal infusion pump permanent implantation requires: (1) documented intractable cancer or non-cancer pain/spasticity, (2) failure of conservative therapies for >= 6 months, (3) psychological clearance, (4) successful temporary trial producing >= 50% relief or documented spasticity reduction.
rules.evidence: Governance-blocked rule. Uncompiled single-condition stub ("cginfusionpumps_indication IS_PRESENT") citing physical page 68. Completely omits multi-step clinical prerequisites and psychological assessment mandates from pages 68–71.
rules.recommended_correction: Maintain governance block. Authorize clinical development of full multi-layered rule tree incorporating trial efficacy (>= 50%), 6-month conservative care, and psychological evaluation.

rules.source_supported_criterion: Sacroiliac joint injections require: axial low back pain below L5 >= 3 months, pain level >= 6/10, cluster of >= 3 positive provocative physical exam tests, failure of conservative therapy >= 6 weeks in last 6 months, fluoroscopy/CT guidance, and >= 75% relief for diagnostic phase.
rules.evidence: Citation mismatch and uncompiled stub. Rule cites physical page 57 (Page 1 of 10, Table of Contents / Header). Clinical criteria are on physical pages 58–60. Condition is a single stub "cgsiinjections_indication IS_PRESENT".
rules.recommended_correction: Update citation to physical pages 58–60 and compile multi-layered clinical criteria: axial pain below L5 >= 3 months, pain >= 6, 3 of 8 provocative tests, 6 weeks conservative care, fluoroscopy.

rules.source_section: Spinal Cord Stimulation 2026 / Permanent Implant Trial Prerequisite
rules.source_supported_criterion: Permanent spinal cord stimulator implant requires documentation of a successful trial of the temporary SCS device providing at least 50% pain relief and functional improvement for a minimum of 3 days.
rules.evidence: Governing policy p. 80 (printed page 4 of 12) explicitly mandates: "Documentation of a successful trial of the temporary SCS device providing at least 50% pain reduction and significant functional improvement for a minimum duration of 3 days". The rule condition scs_trial_pain_relief >= 50 faithfully represents this standard.
rules.recommended_correction: None required. Rule conditions and citation are verified against governing policy.

rules.source_supported_criterion: Interventional pain procedures are preferred in freestanding office or ambulatory surgery center (ASC) settings.
